name: Jesus Mercy
overview: The Scriptures reveal that Jesus' mercy is both a reflection of the Father's compassionate nature and the foundation for salvation. Believers are called to be merciful, knowing that mercy is granted in return, as taught in Matthew 5:7 and Luke 6:36. Jesus emphasizes that God's desire is mercy rather than sacrifice, underscoring His mission to call sinners to repentance (Matthew 9:13). This mercy is ultimately demonstrated in the giving of His Son, so that those who believe may receive eternal life and pass from death to life (John 3:16; John 5:24).
